"The Network Is the Poem" is a 2026 digital humanities essay hosted on Zenodo. It argues that the shape of a text network matters more than the words themselves when looking at AI and literature. The structure creates the meaning.

**Core Ideas**

**Topology over Text.** The connections and pathways between words or ideas matter more than the quality of the individual sentences.

**AI Literature.** It looks at how artificial intelligence builds meaning through connected data networks instead of traditional linear writing.

Would you like to explore how network topology applies to digital poetry, or did you want to discuss a specific part of that essay?
